How is เขตควบคุมการปล่อยมลพิษ used in maritime?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Designated sea region where MARPOL Annex VI limits on SOx, NOx and PM apply; requires low-sulphur fuel or equivalent abatement.

Operational example

Baltic Sea ECA entry in twenty miles; chief engineer confirm change-over to 0.10 percent sulphur marine gas oil complete and record logbook time.
